name: mc-pvp-bots
description: Fight Minecraft PvP bots while Claude works, and get handed back the moment it's done or needs you.

bots.title: Bots in the arena
bots.description: How many bots fight in the free-for-all: 4, 6 or 8

difficulty.title: Bot difficulty
difficulty.description: mixed (rookies to sweats in one lobby), easy, medium or hard (every bot that tier)

dropInSeconds.title: Drop in after (seconds)
dropInSeconds.description: How long Claude must have been working before you are pulled into the arena; short turns never interrupt you

handBackSeconds.title: Hand back after (seconds)
handBackSeconds.description: Grace period between Claude finishing and switching you back to the terminal; the bots freeze at once

graceSeconds.title: Grace countdown (seconds)
graceSeconds.description: Every time you enter or re-enter the arena: a countdown during which you can't be hurt and bots leave you alone

afkSeconds.title: AFK after (seconds)
afkSeconds.description: Mid-fight, no camera movement for this long (you alt-tabbed to Claude) makes you protected and ignored until you move again; 0 turns it off

switchWindows.title: Switch windows for me
switchWindows.description: Bring Minecraft to the front on drop-in and the terminal back when Claude is done or needs you

closeMinecraft.title: Close Minecraft with the arena
closeMinecraft.description: When the arena shuts down (idle, /pvp off, /pvp stop), also close the Minecraft it launched; never any other Minecraft

launcher.title: How Minecraft starts
launcher.description: prism launches a dedicated Prism Launcher instance that joins the arena; manual means you join 127.0.0.1 yourself

prismPath.title: Prism Launcher executable
prismPath.description: Leave empty to find it in the usual install locations

idleMinutes.title: Close the arena after idle (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: The server and bots shut down after this long with Claude idle and nobody fighting

serverPort.title: Minecraft server port
serverPort.description: Local port the arena server listens on (127.0.0.1 only)

controlPort.title: Control port
controlPort.description: Local port the mod uses to talk to the arena daemon
